title: Chapter 2: Understanding Foreign Policy and Diplomacy
content:
❤️ ውድና የተወደዳችሁ የ EthioFresh ቤተሰቦቻችን፣ እንደምን አደራችሁ/ዋላችሁ!
በቅድመ-አያቶቻችን ጥበብና በታላቅ የወንድማማችነት ፍቅር ተሳስረን ለስኬታችሁ የምንተጋው የ EthioFresh ዝግጅት ቡድናችን፣ ዛሬ ደግሞ ለፈተናችሁ ውጤታማነት ትልቅ አስተዋጽኦ የሚያደርገውን የ Global Trends እና International Relations ትምህርት የ Chapter 2 Part 1 ጥልቅ ቱቶሪያል ይዞላችሁ ቀርቧል። በዚህ ክፍል Foreign Policy፣ National Interest፣ የቲዮሪቲካል አመለካከቶች (Realism vs Idealism)፣ ብሔራዊ ጥቅምን ለመወሰን የሚያገለግሉ መስፈርቶች (Criteria) እና የ Foreign Policy Objectives (Short, Middle, and Long Range) በሰፊው ተተንትነዋል። ፍቅራችንና ድጋፋችን ሁልጊዜም ከእናንተ ጋር ነው፤ በርቱ፣ በራስ መተማመናችሁ ይጎልብት! 🚀✨

Introduction

Foreign policy of a state is the actions, decisions, and goals that states pursue towards the outside world. It is shaped by both external/systemic factors and internal factors. International regimes, international organizations, and the prevalence of great powers at the international level are some of the systemic factors that impinge on the foreign policy of a state. Internally, the economic, technological, and military capabilities of states heavily affect foreign policy. On top of these, the idiosyncrasy of leaders contributes much in affecting the foreign policy making and implementation of a country. In this manner, it is important to understand the deriving motives behind foreign policy, viz., the pursuit of national interest. States adopt foreign policy to achieve and promote their national interests often defined as short term, medium term, and long term goals. To this end, states establish diplomatic relations and contacts and use different tactics to protect, often to maximize, their national interest.

👉
የአንድ ሀገር የውጭ ፖሊሲ (Foreign Policy) ማለት ያቺ ሀገር ከሌሎች ሀገራት፣ ከአህጉራዊና ከዓለም አቀፍ ድርጅቶች ጋር የምታደርገውን አጠቃላይ ግንኙነት፣ የምትወስዳቸውን ውሳኔዎች፣ የምትከተላቸውን ስልቶችና የምታስቀምጣቸውን ግቦች የሚወስን አጠቃላይ መመሪያ ነው። የትኛውም ሀገር የውጭ ፖሊሲውን በድንገት አያወጣም፤ ይልቁንም በሁለት ዋና ዋና መነሻዎች ይቃኛል፦
1. የውጭ/ሲስተሚክ ምክንያቶች (External Factors): በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ያሉ ተፅዕኖዎች ሲሆኑ፣ ይህም የኃያላን ሀገራት ፍላጎትና ጫና፣ የዓለም አቀፍ ህጎችና ስምምነቶች፣ እንዲሁም እንደ ህብረት መንግስታት (UN) ያሉ ዓለም አቀፍ ድርጅቶች መመሪያዎችን ያካትታል።
2. የውስጥ ምክንያቶች (Internal Factors): በሀገር ውስጥ ያሉ ተጨባጭ ሁኔታዎች ሲሆኑ፣ ይህም የሀገሪቱ የኢኮኖሚ ጥንካሬ፣ የቴክኖሎጂ ዕድገት ደረጃ፣ የወታደራዊ ዝግጅትና አቅም፣ እንዲሁም የመሪዎች ግላዊ ባህሪ፣ አስተሳሰብና ስብዕና (Idiosyncrasy) ናቸው።
በአጠቃላይ ሀገራት የውጭ ፖሊሲን አዘጋጅተው የሚተገብሩበት ዋነኛውና የመጨረሻው መነሻ ምክንያት የሀገራቸውን ብሔራዊ ጥቅም (National Interest) ለማስጠበቅ፣ ለማስፋፋትና የህልውናቸው መሠረት ለማድረግ ነው።

2.1. Defining National Interest

National interest is the raison d'état (the reason of state), used to justify its actions and policy towards other states at the international level. National interest refers to a set of values, orientation, goals, and objectives a given country would like to achieve in its international relations. It has been the main driving force that determines the contents of foreign policy. However, there are controversies on the exact meaning, scope, and contents of national interests.

However, there is a major division of opinion in the field of international relations regarding whether national interest can be defined objectively or whether it is a subjective enterprise (viz., an art). This debate traces back to Plato's philosophy. For Plato, the good of the polis (the public good) could best be arrived at by a philosopher king aided by a few highly learned, detached, and fair-minded advisors who could make wise decisions without accounting for the yearnings of lesser-minds or accommodating selfish and sectarian pressures. The basic assumptions of this thought include:

  1. Wise and well-informed decisions can be made by a few carefully selected individuals expressly trained to think in terms of the collective good of the state.
  2. These few individuals, who possess awesome and unchecked power, will not be corrupted by this power.
  3. Once socially optimal decisions have been made, they can be implemented effectively by loyal, well-trained, and obedient bureaucracies.

More often, Plato's ideas have been used as inspiration for dictatorial forms of government, assuming that substance of policies should be emphasized rather than procedural issues such as public debate, consultation, participation, and criticism.

👉
ብሔራዊ ጥቅም (National Interest) የሚለው ፅንሰ-ሀሳብ የሀገር ህልውናና የመኖሯ ምስጢር (Raison d'état) ተብሎ ይገለጻል። አንድ ሀገር በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ የምታደርገውን ማንኛውንም ድርድር፣ ውል፣ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ ወይም ወዳጅነት ለመደገፍና ትክክለኛነቱን ለማስረገጥ የምትጠቀምበት መሠረታዊ መለኪያ ነው። ነገር ግን ብሔራዊ ጥቅም ማለት ምን ማለት እንደሆነና ወሰኑ እስከየት እንደሆነ በተለያዩ ምሁራን ዘንድ ልዩነቶች አሉ፦
• A. K. Holsti: ብሔራዊ ጥቅም ማለት ሀገራት በፖሊሲ አውጪዎቻቸው አማካኝነት በሌሎች ሀገራት ላይ ተፅዕኖ በመፍጠርና ባህሪያቸውን በመቀየር ወደፊት በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ማሳካት የሚፈልጉት የተሻለ ሁኔታና ግብ ነው ይላል። ሆልስቲ እንደሚያስምረው፣ ይህንን አላማ ለማሳካት ዋነኛውና መተኪያ የሌለው መሳሪያ Power (ኃይል/ተፅዕኖ የማሳደር አቅም) ነው።
• Seabury: ብሔራዊ ጥቅምን በሁለት መንገድ ይከፍለዋል፦
  1. Normative sense (ሞራላዊ/የሚገባው): አንድ ሀገር በውጭ ግንኙነቷ ማሳካት ይገባታል ተብሎ የሚታመንበት የቅዱስ አላማዎች ስብስብ ነው።
  2. Descriptive sense (ገላጭ/ተጨባጭ): በላቀ ሁኔታ ሀገሪቱ በመሪዎቿ አማካኝነት በሂደትና በተግባር በመሬት ላይ አጥብቃ የምትከተለውና የምታሳካው ግብ ነው።
• Plato (ፕላቶ): የሀገርን ወይም የህዝብን ጥቅም (Public Good) መወሰን ያለበት በልዩ ሁኔታ የሰለጠነ

(ፈላስፋ ንጉሥ) እና ጥቂት የተማሩ አማካሪዎቹ ናቸው ይላል። የፕላቶ ፍልስፍና መነሻዎች፡- ጥቂት የተመረጡ ሰዎች ለሀገር የሚጠቅመውን ውሳኔ መስጠት ይችላሉ፤ እነዚህ ሰዎች በስልጣን አይበላሹም፤ ውሳኔውም በታማኝ ቢሮክራሲ ይተገበራል። ይህም የህዝብ ክርክርን፣ ግልጽነትንና ውይይትን የማያስተናግዱ አምባገነን (Dictatorial) መንግስታት መያዣና መነሻ ሆኖ ያገለግላል።
💡 Exam Hint: በፈተናችሁ ላይ የ A.K. Holsti ትርጓሜ (power እንደ መሳሪያ መጠቀሙ)፣ የ Seabury ክፍፍል (Normative vs Descriptive) እና የ Plato ፍልስፍና (Philosopher King) በ Matching ወይም በጥቅል ጥያቄዎች በብዛት ስለሚመጡ በደንብ ያዟቸው!

Criteria for Determining National Interest

To further complicate the problem of identifying national interest, foreign policy decision is not necessarily a clear-cut and rational process. Multiple conflicting criteria compete for priority in the minds of decision makers. According to Colmbis (1984: 82-87), states use a multiplicity of criteria to define national interest:

CriterionDescription & Key Features
1. Operational PhilosophyDepending on time, location, and orientation, decision makers choose one of two major styles:
- Synoptic Style: Decision maker acts in a bold and sweeping fashion, introducing major new policies and discontinuing others. Assumes having enough information to predict and control outcomes.
- Incremental Style: Decision maker acts with caution, probing, and experimentation (trial-and-error approach). Assumes issues are too complex for bold initiatives, seeking only to perfect existing policies.
2. Ideological CriteriaGovernments establish relations based on ideology (litmus test of ideology). E.g., Cold War era alignments based on Communism vs. Capitalism.
3. Moral and Legal CriteriaActing morally involves honesty, keeping promises/treaties, avoiding exploitation, and standing up for accepted principles. Acting legally means abiding by international law and equity.
4. Pragmatic CriteriaLow-key, matter-of-fact orientation based on prudence, rationality, and cost-benefit analysis rather than emotions, morality, or normative sentiments.
5. Professional Advancement CriteriaPolicy decisions are manipulated for personal/professional success and political survival of bureaucrats ("play the game", "not to rock the boat", "go along to get along" effect). Marked by resistance to new policies.
6. Partisan CriteriaEquating the survival/success of one's political party, ethnic group, or religious group with the survival of the country. Includes bureaucratic battles for budget allocations among offices.
7. Foreign Dependency CriteriaApplies to less developing countries that maintain colonial ties for technical aid, expertise, technology, and security, making them heavily dependent on outside powers for survival.
👉
የአንድ ሀገር መሪዎች ብሔራዊ ጥቅምን በሚወስኑበት ጊዜ በቀላሉና በአንድ መንገድ ብቻ አይወስኑም። የተለያዩ የተወሳሰቡ መስፈርቶችን (7 Criteria) መነሻ ያደርጋሉ፦
1. Operational Philosophy (የአሰራር ፍልስፍና): መሪዎች የሚከተሉት አካሄድ ሲሆን በሁለት ይከፈላል፦
  • Synoptic Style: በአንዴ ትልልቅ፣ ደፋርና ከፍተኛ ለውጥ የሚያመጡ አዳዲስ ፖሊሲዎችን ማውጣትና ነባሮቹን በሙሉ መቀየር። መሪዎች ስለ ሁኔታው ሙሉ መረጃ አለን ብለው ሲያስቡ የሚያደርጉት ነው።
  • Incremental Style: በጥንቃቄ፣ በሙከራና በቀስ በቀስ አሰራር (Trial and Error) ነባር ፖሊሲዎችን ማሻሻል። ጉዳዮች በጣም የተወሳሰቡ ስለሆኑ በደፈናው መወሰን አይቻልም ብለው ሲያስቡ የሚከተሉት ነው፦
2. Ideological Criteria (ርዕዮተ-ዓለማዊ መስፈርት): ወዳጅና ጠላትን በፖለቲካ አስተሳሰብ መለየት (ለምሳሌ በ Cold War ጊዜ በ Capitalism እና Communism መካከል የነበረው አሰላለፍ)።
3. Moral and Legal Criteria (ሞራላዊና ህጋዊ መስፈርት): በዓለም አቀፍ ህጎች፣ በታማኝነት፣ በቃል ኪዳንና በቅንነት ላይ ተመስርቶ መወሰን።
4. Pragmatic Criteria (ተግባራዊ/ጥቅማጥቅም መር መስፈርት): ስሜትን፣ ሞራልንና ህግን ጎን በመተው በጥቅምና ጉዳት ስሌት (Cost-Benefit Analysis) እና በምክንያታዊነት ላይ ብቻ ተመስርቶ መወሰን።
5. Professional Advancement Criteria (የግል/የሙያ ዕድገት መስፈርት): ባለስልጣናትና ቢሮክራቶች የራሳቸውን ስልጣንና ጥቅምና የስራ ዋስትና ለማስጠበቅ ሲሉ የሚወስኑት ውሳኔ ነው ("Go along to get along" / አለቃን ላለማስቀየም አዎ ማለት)።
6. Partisan Criteria (የቡድን/የፓርቲ መስፈርት): የራስን የፖለቲካ ፓርቲ፣ የብሔር ወይም የሃይማኖት ስኬትና ህልውና ከሀገር ህልውና ጋር አጣብቆና አደባልቆ መመልከት።
7. Foreign Dependency Criteria (የውጭ ጥገኝነት መስፈርት): ታዳጊ ሀገራት ለገንዘብ፣ ለቴክኖሎጂና ለደህንነት ሲሉ በኃያላን ሀገራት ላይ ያላቸው ጥገኝነት ብሔራዊ ጥቅማቸውን በራሳቸው ፍላጎት እንዳይወስኑ ማድረጉ ነው።

Realism vs. Idealism in National Interest

Realist Perspective (Hans Morgenthau):
Realist scholars reject ideological, legal, and moral criteria to define national interest. Hans Morgenthau advised leaders to prioritize pragmatic criteria. Morgenthau defines national interest in terms of pursuits of power. In an anarchical international system, power is a means for achieving and promoting state interest. International politics is a struggle among states, making survival and security the prime interests. Morgenthau emphatically argues that pragmatism and practical necessity should be the guiding principles. He also warns leaders to be cautious, prudent, and calculate national interest proportional to their capabilities. A rational diplomat is a prudent diplomat who balances national aspirations against the capabilities and aspirations of others.

Idealist/Liberal Perspective:
Idealists have a strong belief in the relevance of legal, ideological, and moral elements. They do not see legal and moral factors apart from "reality." Actions such as forming alliances, foreign aid, or humanitarian interventions are justified on moral grounds. Furthermore, idealists argue that realists fail to solve global problems due to their exclusive state-centric emphasis. Idealists emphasize cross-cutting global problems (e.g., environmental pollution, ecological imbalance, population growth, poverty, war, arms race, north-south gap) and advocate for global solutions and international institutions rather than national self-help.

👉
• Realism (ሃንስ ሞርገንታው): ሪያሊስቶች ዓለም አቀፍ ፖለቲካ የኃይልና የህልውና ትግል መስክ ነው ብለው ያምናሉ። ሞራል፣ ህግና ርዕዮተ-ዓለም ቦታ የላቸውም። ብሔራዊ ጥቅም የሚገለፀው በPower (ኃይል) እና በSurvival (ህልውና) ነው፤ ስለዚህ መሪዎች ስሜታዊ ሳይሆኑ አስተዋይና ብልህ (Prudent) በመሆን የሀገራቸውን አቅም ያገናዘበ ውሳኔ መስጠት አለባቸው።
• Idealism/Liberalism: አይዲያሊስቶች ደግሞ ዓለም አቀፍ ህጎች፣ ሞራል፣ የሰብዓዊ መብቶችና ዓለም አቀፍ ተቋማት ለሰላም ወሳኝ ናቸው ይላሉ። እንደ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ፣ ድህነት፣ የህዝብ ቁጥር መጨመርና ጦርነት ያሉ አጠቃላይ ዓለም አቀፍ ችግሮች በአንድ ሀገር ጥረት ብቻ ሳይሆን በዓለም አቀፍ ትብብርና ተቋማት ይፈታሉ ብለው ያምናሉ።
